issues.summary: 8/16-bit integer and char increment/decrement expression value returns widened int or post-increment value
issues.avoidedShape: Pre/post increment or decrement (++ / --) on sbyte, byte, short, ushort, or char in value-consuming expression contexts; only statement-level increment/decrement is emitted when avoided.

issues.summary: Null-coalescing operator (??) between Nullable<T> of different widths or narrow Nullable<T> implicit promotion
issues.avoidedShape: Null-coalescing operator (??) where left and right operands have different underlying types or widths, or where a narrow Nullable<T> is implicitly promoted.

issues.summary: Nullable<T> local variable declarations fail C++ / CUDA transpilation or runtime lowering
issues.avoidedShape: Local variable declarations of type Nullable<T> (T?); Nullable<T> is instead exercised via struct fields on profiles C and G.

issues.summary: Binding a C++ reference to a misaligned field of a Pack = 1 struct triggers CUDA misaligned address fault
issues.avoidedShape: Passing a misaligned field of a [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 1)] struct to ref/out/in parameters, ref ternary, tuple deconstruction target, compound assignment, or ??= target.

issues.summary: Instance methods of plain structs called from device code are not emitted or diagnosed
issues.avoidedShape: Calling plain struct instance methods directly from kernels; computed readonly properties and [GpuDeviceFunction] helpers are used when avoided.
